folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B152, 2026-11-04
folds.body:
The full operation/lens/comic and domain crosswalk was reviewed. Preserve owner-qualified CL namespaces: kit lens, comic law and crafting codex are not the same IDs. Observation, forecast, disclosure blocking, pending decision manipulation and actual past-truth change have different consumers. A status card or recorded grant does not implement any of them, and a hidden UI alone does not implement Blind (AD32, AD38).

Packet restrictions on rerolling owned mixtures or settled effects describe its proposed pending-decision adapter. A separately admitted retrospective rewrite, loop, copying or fate mechanism may change its actual domain; no universal ban or compulsory luck debt follows. Exact forecasts require their real dependencies, and an actual future-binding power can preserve a future by its mechanism. Basic known-record display remains ordinary UI, while a mind-reading or exact-knowledge means can reveal the truth it genuinely reaches. Stacked capabilities retain their actual scopes and can combine valid information without being granted unrelated omniscience.

Current viewport, AD42 human-review status, AD51 shared-seam direction and later merged appearance/story/cheat consumers qualify old source/queue assumptions. Bare proposal ports and two-consumer examples are neither reserved file areas nor a broad refactor gate. Linked owner bodies, source canon and actual native routes were not newly verified by this crosswalk read.

folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B152, 2026-11-04
folds.body:
A1-A7 were read completely. Retain its distinctions: stable root, mutable cursor, keyed derivation, saved resolved output and rolling receipt log are different owners. A keyed helper can avoid advancing a cursor while still appending receipts or initializing streams; that is not byte-pure preview. An instance specification called seed is not automatically PRNG entropy. Pure draw wrappers may omit a saved cell salt unless the caller passes the correct context; exact future predictions therefore need the real consuming resolver (AD32, AD36, AR6).

This audit already records native seededRecipe versus unbound recipe fallback, confirming the caller correction to B145. Its original 27-reference/ten-transition census and line locations are dated. Later merged kit/appearances/spine and population revisions qualify its absent/wave-1/exactly-three rows; no current global count or conformance proof is inferred. All listed tests were inspected, not executed by this audit. A Node encoded-file test does not exercise the native file picker or prove full native Import.

Physical execution may read actual world truth, while decision explanations, hints, sort/count, prices, accessibility and exported summaries need the relevant observer projection. A discovered event is not permission to dump its whole internal frozen effects/receipts. Ordinary hidden-trait counts were a local design, not a universal disclosure default. Preserve committed outcomes and frozen response terms beyond a rolling diagnostic log; revisioning must not reinterpret old products through changed laws without the chosen compatibility policy. A selected port reuses the authoritative owners rather than copying inventory/people/history into GA2.

folds.heading: ## Procedural helper audit application B152, 2026-11-04
folds.body:
The full [GX4 source audit](gm/dispatch/procgen-2026-10-13/gx4/AUDIT.md) and [GX2 crosswalk](gm/dispatch/procgen-2026-10-13/gx2/RECONCILIATION.md), plus five lane checkpoints, were reviewed. Useful checks for a selected generator: cursor-neutral is not automatically mutation-free, a rolling receipt log is not durable truth, a saved seed is not a complete table/algorithm revision contract, and an observer-safe display cannot be obtained by showing every field of a discovered event. Track actual committed outcomes, supported observer knowledge and required causal history in their existing owners (GR1-GR5, GR10, GR15, AD36).

The old source audit correctly distinguishes native Proxy-seeded recipe commits from unbound recipe fallback. Preserve the current caller contract rather than rebuilding R3-1 from method names alone. Local helper and record snapshots need exact current-source checks before a port; no one generic envelope should replace existing combat, job, inventory or continuation authorities. Tests that cover import serialization, native file selection, failed publication and a real consumer answer different questions.

GX1-GX4 complete documentation, not gameplay. GX5 records a bounded earned appearance route on its own bundle and later has a separate integration receipt. Structural profile/title/link counts, zero-secret manual review and source hashes do not certify complete canon, every future leak or whole-world floor. Old human gates, 1366 targets, proposed ports and lane reservations are history. Known shared needs may be designed with the first consumer under AD51, then validated by a different consumer; no new implementation or universal migration is selected.
